structural_logreg_sonics_lasso.notes: Secondary structural classifier (lasso). Same 28 features as structural_logreg_sonics but L1 regularisation (penalty='l1', solver='liblinear'). Zeros out weak features for a sparse, interpretable model. Displayed as 'Sparse Logistic Regression (L1)' in the UI. Notably, mel_interval_std is the dominant AI signal — opposite direction from the stems model where all_interval_std pointed human, suggesting SONICS AI melodies have higher interval variability than stems-only AI.
